title: FLA import: readCPicSwf is not defined — pages 1/6/7/8 import as empty scenes, game stuck on blank first scene
description:
When loading Magnet.fla, 4 page streams fail with:

  [FLA import] could not parse page stream "Page 1": ReferenceError: readCPicSwf is not defined — importing empty scene
  [FLA import] could not parse page stream "Page 6": ReferenceError: readCPicSwf is not defined — importing empty scene
  [FLA import] could not parse page stream "Page 7": ReferenceError: readCPicSwf is not defined — importing empty scene
  [FLA import] could not parse page stream "Page 8": ReferenceError: readCPicSwf is not defined — importing empty scene
  Source: flash8-import.ts:835

Page 1 maps to scene "AA" (index 0, the FIRST scene in the SWF). Since this scene is empty, the game starts but has no AS2 scripts to navigate to other scenes. Test Movie renders only the cyan/light-blue background color (the document backgroundColor) with no game content.

Scenes 2 (index 1) and 5 (index 2) DO parse successfully and have real content (objects + scripts per doc_summary). So the issue is confined to pages whose binary stream contains a CPicSwf object that triggers readCPicSwf — a function referenced in the page parser but not defined in scope.

Expected: all page streams should parse successfully. Pages 1/6/7/8 contain CPicSwf-backed objects (Claw.swft, claw2.swft) that need readCPicSwf to be defined/imported in flash8-import.ts. Without scene 1, the game cannot progress from its opening frame.

Note: 0892 tracks "CPicSwf class not supported" (from flash8-binary.ts). This bug (0902) is different — it is a ReferenceError in flash8-import.ts where readCPicSwf is called but not in scope.
